text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'UKV's mean absolute error minus ERA5's, in points of capacity. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Exploratory. The post-upgrade rows rest on 8 months, so their intervals are likely too narrow. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026.'
text.tspan: UKV's mean absolute error minus ERA5's, in points of capacity. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output.
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Exploratory.
The post-upgrade rows rest on 8 months, so their intervals are likely too narrow.
Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026.
